name: Three-breaker two-source transfer interface
aliases: switchgear Switchboard source and bus interfaces
summary: Relates the two incoming breakers and one bus tie in a defined source-transfer system.
description: Relates the two incoming breakers and one bus tie in a defined source-transfer system. A source and bus arrangement shows how incoming supplies and outgoing circuits can be connected. Breaker and tie positions determine which sections are energized and whether sources can become electrically paralleled.

In a switchgear lineup with two incomers and a bus tie, the single-line arrangement helps the engineer identify normal supply paths and which loads change source during a transfer. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Three breaker positions” at the input and “Transfer arrangement” at the output. The interlock matrix determines allowed combinations.

Keep normal positions, transfer limits, source independence and protection-zone boundaries visible.
